bosses.name: Checkpoint Celine
bosses.design: A tall white and red alien gatekeeper with a horseshoe-shaped body arch, expressive face at top, two long striped legs, two slim arms, violet eye visor and small gold cheek panels. Biological arch-shaped anatomy.

bosses.name: Clockwork Cormac
bosses.design: A bronze clockwork snail alien with giant gear-shaped shell, long teal expressive face and two eyes on short stalks, two articulated arms, broad segmented foot. Visible decorative gears but no clock numbers or extra text.

bosses.name: Mate-in-One Marnie
bosses.design: A vivid pink single-eyed alien arrowhead with a huge triangular head, tiny athletic black body, two long pink arms and two long feet, one large expressive cyan eye and small mouth. Bold sharp clean silhouette.

bosses.name: Endboss Evelyn
bosses.design: A towering black obsidian alien empress with a floating purple diamond head, two bright expressive gold eyes and mouth, broad floating shoulder plates, two angular arms, tapered levitating lower body. Magenta seams, commanding regal silhouette without handheld prop.

bosses.name: Crowncrusher Clara
bosses.design: A pale lavender rhinoceros beetle alien with a huge gold crescent horn, stout armored body, two expressive orange eyes, two massive forearms and four stubby legs. Pink chitin joints, powerful playful champion.

bosses.name: Royal Rumble Rafi
bosses.design: A crimson four-armed alien gorilla with a wide expressive ivory face, two teal eyes, broad chest, two stocky legs and small fan-shaped silver ear plates. Thick rounded anatomy, showy arena champion.

bosses.name: Check Raid Ramon
bosses.design: A sleek emerald alien wolf centaur with expressive long muzzle, two orange eyes, two upright ears, two humanoid forearms on upper chest and four running legs, white dorsal spines. Purple chest armor plate, distinct six-limb silhouette.

bosses.name: Mate Collector Mabel
bosses.design: A plum-colored hermit-crab alien carrying a tall asymmetrical ivory shell with tiny chess-piece-shaped natural growths, two large gold expressive eyes, two fine claws and four legs. Curious eccentric collector, cyan shell markings.

bosses.name: Fortress Fiona
bosses.design: A huge turquoise living geode alien, hollow crystalline cavern torso with expressive amber face at center, four massive rock legs and two short rock arms, lavender crystal rim. Squat protective fortress silhouette, no scenery.

bosses.name: Tournament Titan Toby
bosses.design: A towering orange three-legged alien titan with a tall cylindrical head, three expressive blue eyes around face, two enormous segmented arms, cream armored belly and small teal shoulder fins. Monumental but friendly arcade champion.

bosses.name: Matchpoint Max
bosses.design: A silver liquid-metal alien shaped as a twisting hourglass with expressive two-eyed black face in upper bulb, two fluid ribbon arms and two pointed feet, orange core glow contained in body. Sleek dynamic reflective silhouette.

bosses.name: Checkmate Cindy
bosses.design: A majestic white and gold celestial serpent alien with a large expressive feminine face, two violet eyes, sweeping six-point halo-like natural head fins, two elegant arms and one long coiled serpentine lower body. Black-and-magenta diamond scales, unmistakable final champion, no handheld props.
